identity.question: Will UK GDP growth in Q3 2026 be between 0.4% and 0.5%?

contract.measure: UK real GDP quarter-on-previous-quarter % change, Q3 2026, in ONS GDP first quarterly estimate, UK
contract.resolution_uses: Initial release only; resolution precision one decimal place; later revisions do not change settlement. If Q3 is not released by the next quarter estimate date, use last available quarter.

ons_august_release.note: Monthly August estimate is output-only; quarterly estimates average output, income and expenditure approaches. Three-month-to-Aug is not Q3 itself.

ons_monthly_gva_index.dataset: MGDP; series ECY2 Gross Value Added - Monthly (Index 1dp), CVM SA; ECYX monthly growth and ED3H rolling 3m/3m growth are also in CSV. Dataset release 2026-10-15; July version 2026-09-11, preceding version 2026-08-13.

descriptive_carry_in.limitation: Arithmetic on published 1dp output-based GVA index levels only; September absent. This is not a Q3 GDP estimate and cannot resolve the three-approach quarterly measure.

q2_comparison.relevance: Shows why the contract’s initial-release clause matters; revised Q2 is not a substitute for Q3 initial estimate.

forecast_context.source: Bank of England September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
forecast_context.dated_value: Staff update implied Q3 GDP growth 0.4%, based on July monthly release; July Report projection had been 0.1%. Precedes 15-Oct August GDP data.

forecast_context.source: NIESR October GDP Tracker, “Headwinds Are Mounting”
forecast_context.dated_value: Public summary forecasts 0.7% Q3 and 0.2% Q4; full report restricted to members/subscribers.

official_facts.revision_note: ONS August monthly release revised June from 0.3% to 0.4% and the 3m/3m June and July measures from 0.4% to 0.5%; it says revisions back to Jan1997-Jun2026 align with 30-Sep quarterly accounts/Blue Book 2026. August level dataset is current as of 15-Oct.

limits: September monthly GDP is not yet published; September and Q3 first estimate are both scheduled 12-Nov 07:00 UTC.
No independent second nowcast found/captured beyond dated BoE staff update and NIESR tracker.
No own probability, market quote, or settlement conclusion supplied.
